methodology.enumParser: TypeScript compiler AST over DocumentType and CollectionViewType
methodology.prototypeParser: TypeScript compiler AST over the initial TemplateMap and every TemplateMap.set registration under src/client
methodology.factoryParser: TypeScript compiler AST over Docs.Create and calls to InstanceFromProto or Prototypes.get

commonDataFields.why: Persist the initial guest permission on the shared data owner.
Carry system ownership from the view-only option split to the data owner.
Mark the shared delegate target explicitly.
Initialize the primary content field timestamp.
Store the factory-supplied typed value under the selected primary key.
Pre-create the annotation list so AddOnly users can append without creating a forbidden field.
Pre-create the primary field sidebar list.

commonViewFields.why: Record who created the contextual delegate.
Allow the view delegate to have a context-local guest ACL.

commonViewFields.field: x, y, size, overlay, z-index, and other _ fields
commonViewFields.why: Keep placement and presentation contextual instead of shared with every delegate.

sequence: Imported renderer modules execute TemplateMap registrations.
loadUserDocument calls Prototypes.initialize after the client/server identity handshake.
initialize batch-loads <serialized-type>Proto IDs, builds missing prototypes, and fills PrototypeMap.
Factories retrieve a prototype, create a data delegate, then normally create a view delegate.
DocumentContentsView resolves the inherited layout string and parses it with the registered component map.
